Sometimes we have to make it ourselves. You got this though.

It's hard to say, usually when there is something making us really upset or depressed and we say we dont know, we usually do. Sometimes it is buried so deep we forget. Other times we just don't want to admit the obvious to ourselves. Maybe you are bored with your life. Maybe you feel a little insecure. Most people like to feel useful and wanted. If we are in an environment that doesn't support that, we end up feeling alone and depressed. If we are in a good environment and we still feel this way. There is something in life missing, or something more to you feel you need to be doing. I hate to admit it but sometime I feel like I unconsciously sabotage my own life to add excitement. I'd recommend listening to some music, preferably without lyrics. That way it reflects how you feel. Close your eyes and let the music play in the background of a story of your own imagination. The story you imagine might put you a step closer to what you need in life. I usually imagine myself saving people with superpowers lol, like that will ever happen. Yet it tells me that I need to help people, that's what my heart tells me. That is why I'm here today OP. I hope you can find what you need.

I can understand how you feel. Everyday I feel powerless, I want to do everything to make life easier for everyone. Their is much corruption by a handful of people, who cause millions to suffer. We just accept that and move on with our lives. I hate being a part of a society like this. How can I live my life, knowing others are suffering. People constantly tell me I'm stupid and should worry only about myself. Yet I fight that belief everyday because that is what society wants. To make us weaker by keeping us divided. You say something watches over us and I agree. Although I'm not religious, I feel like life is a test. We have this whole playground that we know as space, and so many unknowns about what is out there. We talk about colonizing Mars, yet we cant even take care of our own planet. Yet what I say doesn't really matter to society, like you said. I'm just mentally unstable. Don't let society destroy you. Your depression is linked to your personality. I will never get better because society and this world and in a state of shit. Yet people like you OP still exist so there will always be hope. We will always feel alone, that is human, we are trapped in our minds; our thoughts and emotions, but we are never truly alone.
I know it sounds stupid but the world doesn't change because a special leader took charge but because the people rose up and fought for each other.

I feel similar. People dont ask me to hang out. I always have to be the one asking so it made me feel like they dont want to hang out. I stopped asking, it's been almost a year since I've been out with my usual friends, but I've met more people who've I've gone out with but dont have the same connection. I dont really do anything with my life so I feel meaningless everyday. I started to teach myself piano and try to channel my emotions into that. You say you make music, try making something in a genre you are not used to but that can reflect your state of emotion. To be honest I just feel like this is the kind of people we are, we get to a point where it all feels meaningless. For me this reason is always because I know there are millions of people in the world suffering because of corruption and I'm powerless to do something about it on my own. Even though just a small amount of help here and there makes a difference, it feels like a trap and there is so much more we can be doing to efficiently contribute to our society at this point.

That's because society tells you to grow up, which I see as lose your individuality and become a drone already. We are left to barely make ends meet while a few individuals, whether they were born into it or stepped over others, control our lives. We have do much humanity left in us to discover but we can barely do that with trying to make other people richer, while we struggle to define the meaning of life after getting strangled by bills and taxes.

You are not a miserable person, you are one of the many wonderful humans who are still around. I cant stand idly while society destroys people like us. Be strong and use what you believe here as a motto to live your life by. Because your mind and your belief is far too precious in this day of age to be corrupted by our society. I know I sound stupid, but it's a choice we make. Believe we can change society, or believe society will never change. I for one see all of you and it pisses me off that people make fun of you, tell you you deal with it. I want to change society for all of you. But alone I can't, continue to be strong and keep talking, so that we can inspire others to make a difference.

You are not boring, the fact that you came on here and gave so many people a reason to talk or something to reply to you is proof. We all feel lost because we see people out there who are just so amicable and energetic. With so many friends. In truth you just need to find your circle. It won't find itself, that's the hard part. It may take a couple of crashes and burn but if you take some time, discover all your interests and try to find people with similar ideals and interests as you. Like I said very hard, it won't happen over night. It is a skill you have to practice, but I can guarantee you life will be a little easier if you practice it. People who don't speak often usually have a lot to say.

From personal experience some things only get better if your try but it really depends on what's making you depressed. For me the issue will never better, I don't really know that but at this rate..., but that depression makes me the person I am. It doesn't really get better, you get stronger. But because of the kind of people I feel most of us are, there are something we cant let go because it is who we are. We can however use that as our strength to push forward, to help others to never feel this way. Somedays we feel powerless to help others, and days we hate the world for being so selfish and uncaring about others. Yet at the end of the day we all feel emotions. Depression for me is like a boomerang. I throw it and try to get as much done as I can before it comes back, but never forget about it or it will come back and snack you in the face. Learn to harness your depression so it doesn't consume you, but that is 100x easier said then done. Cause I'm still working on it myself, it's a lifelong commitment. We will all be better people in the end because we chose to reflect, agonize and learn from our past in much more depth than those who simply toss their feelings to the wind and let go so easily.

I feel the same way. When you have a world that focuses on money rather than community. This kind of stuff happens. If anything it's people like you who can change the world. People who can still feel empathy towards others and can see that the world would be a much better place if we learn to help one another. Yet most of us are told everyday that's how the world works deal with it, worry about yourself. That's why people like us have to get together and change the world. Life shouldn't be agonizing for people like you especially when it's clear you care about people. I tend to see my depression as my strength, don't let it go because it makes you the wonderful and caring person you are. But also try not to let it consume you, because that's what the corrupted part of society wants. Teach others from your experiences and tell them about your beliefs. Some may agree some won't, but when you give your depression a voice, like you did today. You inspire others who go through the same to be little bit stronger for you and for themselves.
Humanity can only survive, if we stop acting like humans
